notes.title: Circuit Cheat Fixed
notes.content: 1. At request I have added 2 checkpoints to the AI circuit race to fix from cheating the time. Thank you <redacted> player for messaging me about the issue.

notes.title: Breakpoint Crash Fix / Level Editor Edge Panning
notes.content:
1. Removed code causing possible breakpoint exceptions that would then possibly crash the game for the player.
2. Added code for edge panning in level editor (this fixes a bug for some users that stops them from panning the camera using mouse input)

notes.title: Custom Level Bug Fix
notes.content:
1. Fixed bug with penalty carrying over to custom levels when starting
2. Fixed bug with reset car when falling of the map

notes.title: Sponsorship Bonuses Fixed | Daily Login Reward Fixed
notes.content:
I had a great review letting me know these issues existed. I knocked them out. (Allegedly) there are still issues getting to 4th gear or above? Please let me know if you have any issues!

1. Sponsorships fixed: you will now get rewards from sponsors
2. Daily rewards fixed: you will now get credit rewards from daily logins

I never do anything right the first time :)
